column1: # Remaining branches approved for removal on 2026-11-03.
# The cleanup workflow deletes a branch ONLY if its current SHA still equals `sha`
# AND its commits are preserved: recovery=main -> sha is an ancestor of main;
# recovery=pull/N/head -> PR #N head SHA equals `sha` (GitHub keeps PR refs forever).
# Restore a branch: git fetch origin <recovery>:<branch>   (for recovery=main: git branch <branch> <sha>)
